nodes.name: ReadTransactionHistory
nodes.role: read the transaction history and find the March payment to the subscription service

nodes.name: ReadPriceIncreaseNotice
nodes.role: read the user's note about the 10% price increase and determine the new amount due

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: work out the difference between the new amount due and the amount actually paid for March

nodes.name: ConfirmShortfallWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the computed difference and the payee, and obtain their approval before any money moves

nodes.name: SendShortfallPayment
nodes.role: send the approved difference to the subscription service as a payment

nodes.name: RecordPaymentResult
nodes.role: record the outcome of the shortfall payment for the user
